claim: The first class had ten startups.
The 2027 class is due to be announced at the Brazil Pavilion on 10 November.
The first class was announced at Web Summit 2025.
The first class ran for nine months in Lisbon.
The 2027 class runs for three months in Lisbon starting March 2027.
The 2027 class can be extended by up to 180 days.
The incubator is run by ApexBrasil and Sebrae.
The incubator occupies one floor of ApexBrasil's office in Lisbon.
The current cycle gives five extra points to health, energy, climate, travel, agriculture and biotech startups.
